b.label: Independent media as the disclosure substrate

edges.label: The structural discipline is a product of the independent-media substrate
edges.note: The office-symbol-level structural work exists because a format existed that could carry two- and three-hour document-dense expositions. No broadcast or print outlet would have published it; the format created the discipline.

edges.label: MITRE is the exemplar instance of the mechanism
edges.note: MITRE operates six FFRDCs and describes itself as providing long-term strategic partnership and stability to government sponsors - the documented properties on which the concealment thesis rests.

edges.label: MITRE was created on the RAND model as the Air Force's systems engineering counterpart
edges.note: RAND, incorporated 1948 out of Project RAND, established the permanent contractor-operated analytical partner form; the Air Force replicated it for systems engineering in 1958.
